2607.28568.title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
2607.28568.paper_summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability. We introduce OpenMLE, an open full-stack system for RSI research in MLE, spanning verifiable task environments with execution feedback (OpenMLE-Gym), operator learning (OpenMLE-RL), and long-horizon search (OpenMLE-Evo). On this stack we post-train Frontis-MA1 (35B) as a meta-evolution agent for MLE, aligning post-training and inference around four atomic program-evolution operators (Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover): the same operators are trained via execution-grounded SFT and RL on data deduplicated against all evaluation benchmarks, then composed into long-horizon search, coupling learning and evolution in a single loop. On MLE-Bench Lite under a 12-hour per-task budget on one RTX 4090 capped at 12 GB VRAM, Frontis-MA1 (35B) improves Medal Average from 39.39% to 60.61% over its base model with OpenMLE-Evo, and reaches 71.21% with OpenMLE-Evo-Max (benchmark-independent experience priors and asynchronous search), exceeding GPT-5.5 + Codex and approaching GPT-5.6 Sol and the 2.8T Kimi K3. On held-out NatureBench Lite, both components transfer: with the framework fixed, swapping in the trained model raises Match-SOTA from 50% to 70%; with the model fixed, swapping in OpenMLE-Evo raises it from 20% to 50%. We release the model weights and the full OpenMLE stack to enable reproducible research on executable AI4AI toward RSI. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/OpenRSI
2607.28568.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸自我改進（RSI）需要能夠改善建造 AI 的過程的 AI 系統（即 AI4AI）；機器學習工程（MLE）提供了一個具體的、可執行的測試平台來研究這一能力。<lb/>我們介紹 OpenMLE，一個開放的全棧系統，用於 MLE 中的 RSI 研究，涵蓋可驗證的任務環境及執行反饋（OpenMLE-Gym）、操作學習（OpenMLE-RL）和長期搜索（OpenMLE-Evo）。<lb/>在這個堆疊上，我們對 Frontis-MA1（35B）進行後訓練，作為 MLE 的元進化代理，圍繞四個原子程序進化操作（草稿、改進、調試、交叉）對後訓練和推理進行對齊：這些相同的操作通過執行基礎的 SFT 和 RL 在與所有評估基準去重的數據上進行訓練，然後組合成長期搜索，將學習和進化結合在一個循環中。<lb/>在 MLE-Bench Lite 上，在一個 RTX 4090 限制在 12 GB VRAM 的情況下，每個任務的預算為 12 小時，Frontis-MA1（35B）通過 OpenMLE-Evo 將 Medal Average 從 39.39% 提高到 60.61%，並在 OpenMLE-Evo-Max（基準獨立經驗先驗和異步搜索）下達到 71.21%，超越 GPT-5.5 + Codex，接近 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 2.8T Kimi K3。<lb/>在保留的 NatureBench Lite 上，兩個組件均有轉移：在框架固定的情況下，替換訓練模型將 Match-SOTA 從 50% 提高到 70%；在模型固定的情況下，替換 OpenMLE-Evo 將其從 20% 提高到 50%。<lb/>我們發布模型權重和完整的 OpenMLE 堆疊，以促進可重複的可執行 AI4AI 研究，朝向 RSI。<lb/>代碼：https://github.com/FrontisAI/OpenRSI
